dict.string: Kilele shows what's playing in Music or Spotify and lets you pause or skip from the notch.
Kilele shows a short notice in the notch when headphones or other Bluetooth devices connect.
Kilele shows your next events when you hover over the notch.
Kilele shows a camera mirror in the notch when you open it, for a quick look before a call.
Kilele puts new screenshots on the shelf.
Kilele puts new downloads on the shelf and shows when a download is in progress.
Kilele records voice memos into your notes when you press the record button.
Kilele shows reminders due today and lets you tick them off from the notch.
